context.title: Kings of North and South
context.summary: The angel describes a long series of wars between 'the king of the north' and 'the king of the south,' ending with a ruler who defiles the sanctuary, while the faithful stand firm.
context.background: The kings are widely identified with the Seleucid rulers of Syria (north) and the Ptolemies of Egypt (south), who fought over Judea after Alexander. The 'vile person' (v. 21) is commonly identified as Antiochus IV, and many see the 'ships of Chittim' (v. 30) as the Roman fleet that forced him out of Egypt in 168 BC. From verse 36 on, interpreters divide over whether he or a future figure is in view.

customs.note: A sacrilege that empties the temple of true worship; Jesus used the phrase of a future desecration.

watchFor: 'The people that do know their God shall be strong' (v. 32), even as suffering refines the wise (v. 35).

people.name: Esau
people.summary: Hairy, Rebekah’s first-born twin son (Gen. 25:25). The name of Edom, “red”, was also given to him from his conduct in connection with the red lentil “pottage” for which he sold his birthright (30, 31).

people.name: Moab
people.summary: Used to denote the people of Moab (Num. 22:3-14; Judg. 3:30; 2 Sam. 8:2; Jer. 48:11, 13).

places.name: Greece
places.summary: Orginally consisted of the four provinces of Macedonia, Epirus, Achaia, and Peleponnesus. In Acts 20:2 it designates only the Roman province of Macedonia.

places.name: Persia
places.summary: An ancient empire, extending from the Indus to Thrace, and from the Caspian Sea to the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf. The Persians were originally a Medic tribe which settled in Persia, on the eastern side of the Persian Gulf.

places.name: Egypt
places.summary: The land of the Nile and the pyramids, the oldest kingdom of which we have any record, holds a place of great significance in Scripture.

places.name: Edom
places.summary: Idumea (Isa. 34:5, 6; Ezek. 35:15). “The field of Edom” (Gen. 32:3), “the land of Edom” (Gen. 36:16), was mountainous (Obad. 1:8, 9, 19, 21).

places.name: Moab
places.summary: The land of Moab (Jer. 48:24), called also the “country of Moab” (Ruth 1:2, 6; 2:6), on the east of Jordan and the Dead Sea, and south of the Arnon (Num. 21:13, 26).

events.title: Prophecies of Daniel
events.summary: Passage: Daniel 1:1–12:13. People: Daniel. Lasted about 72 years.
